narrative.intro: Loyal Source Government Services reported $1.8B in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date, with 18 awards and an average award size of $102M. Loyal Source Government Services obligations are up 105.0% year over year. Loyal Source Government Services activity is concentrated with the Department of Veterans Affairs, which obligated $1.8B so far this fiscal year. Loyal Source Government Services shows a clear focus on health-related NAICS markets: Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) account for $1.8B and Temporary Help Services account for $74.3M. Loyal Source Government Services has smaller obligations in Offices of All Other Miscellaneous Health Practitioners at $1.3M and a $500 obligation in Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences. The company’s obligations grew from $244M in FY21 to $1.8B in FY26, with intermediate totals of $173M in FY22, $374M in FY23, $546M in FY24, and $900M in FY25. This snapshot covers fiscal year to date totals and award counts, not full-year results or projections.

sections.heading: Who are Loyal Source Government Services top buyers this fiscal year?
sections.body: Department of Veterans Affairs is the top buyer with $1.8B in obligations. Department of Homeland Security is the next listed buyer with $75.8M. Department of Defense appears with $1.4M in obligations for FY2026 to date.

sections.heading: What markets and contract types does Loyal Source Government Services serve?
sections.body: Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) is the largest market at $1.8B. Temporary Help Services is the secondary market at $74.3M, with additional work in Offices of All Other Miscellaneous Health Practitioners at $1.3M and Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences at $500. Facilities Support Services is listed with $0 in obligations.

faq.q: How much does Loyal Source Government Services make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Loyal Source Government Services makes $1.8B from federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Loyal Source Government Services recorded 18 awards this fiscal year with an average award size of $102M, and obligations are up 105.0% year over year.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Loyal Source Government Services?
faq.a: Department of Veterans Affairs, Department of Homeland Security, and Department of Defense buy from Loyal Source Government Services. Department of Veterans Affairs obligated $1.8B, Department of Homeland Security obligated $75.8M, and Department of Defense obligated $1.4M for FY2026 to date.

faq.q: What does Loyal Source Government Services sell to the government?
faq.a: Loyal Source Government Services sells primarily medical and staffing services to the government. Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) accounts for $1.8B, Temporary Help Services accounts for $74.3M, and Offices of All Other Miscellaneous Health Practitioners accounts for $1.3M; the firm also shows a $500 obligation in Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences and $0 in Facilities Support Services.
